resources.string: block the ones you don\'t want
Payments and income from %s won\'t be recorded automatically any more. To skip one shop or payee only, use blocked keywords instead.
Their notifications are never recorded. Switches apply at once.
None yet. Turn on the switch next to an app below.
Only WeChat, Alipay and the payment apps you turned on are read, so other apps aren\'t recorded anyway. After turning on \"Also read other apps\", blocking matters for them.
Payment source · automatic recording uses it
If the payee, shop or notification text contains one of these words, it isn\'t recorded. Good for money moved between your own accounts.
None yet. Type one above, or tap a recent payee below.
Tap to add to the block list
Recorded, waiting for an amount or confirmation%s
Looks like a payment, but the format is new%s
When a payment notification arrives, this shows whether it was recorded and why.
Tap a category to delete it; past entries keep it. \"Other\" is used when no category is chosen and can\'t be deleted.
Not set. Your most frequent recent amounts are used; add some below to fix them.
Tap to add to the list above
No history yet: the card opens the keyboard right away.
With a note but no category, the app checks: your rules → the category you picked before for this note → common built-in words. Only if nothing fits does it use \"Other\".
A word in the note or payee, e.g. Starbucks
None. Usually you don\'t need any: pick a category for a note once and the app remembers it.
To change one, re-categorise entries with that note (the more frequent choice wins), or add a rule above (rules win).
The basics are set. Do the background settings below too, so nothing is missed with the screen off for long.
Items marked red aren\'t done yet; payments may be missed.
The system is passing notifications to the app
Access is on but it isn\'t connected: tap to reconnect
Sends a test notification and checks the app receives it right away. It disappears after a few seconds and isn\'t recorded.
Received (%s s). Automatic recording works on this phone.
Notification access is off. Tap \"Notification access\" above.
The app may not post notifications, so it can\'t test. Allow notifications for it in system settings and try again (only used for this test).
Nothing within 6 seconds. Tap \"Notification listener connected\" to reconnect and try again; if it still fails, do the background settings below, or turn notification access off and on.
Can\'t open it; please follow the path above
Menu names differ a little between system versions. If \"Open settings\" can\'t find the page, it opens the app\'s info page instead.
Phone model, system, permissions and the recent recognition log, for the developer
Contains: phone model, system version, permissions, the last 80 log entries (recorded or not, and why). No amounts or notes from your ledger.
Needed to fix unrecognised formats; may contain payee names
Open Recents (the multitasking view), find this app\'s card, pull it down or long-press it and tap Lock. \"Clear all\" then leaves it running.
Security → Manage apps → Permissions → Autostart, turn it on for this app.
Settings → Apps → Manage apps → this app → Battery saver → No restrictions.
Settings → Apps & services → App launch → this app: turn off \"Manage automatically\", then allow auto-launch, secondary launch and running in background.
Settings → Apps → App launch → this app: turn off \"Manage automatically\", then allow auto-launch, secondary launch and running in background.
Settings → Apps → Auto launch (or Phone Manager → Privacy permissions → Startup manager), turn it on for this app.
Settings → Battery → More settings / App battery management → this app: allow background activity, turn off \"smart\" restrictions.
Settings → Battery → Background power consumption management → this app → Allow high background power consumption.
i Manager → App manager → Permission manager → Autostart (or Settings → Apps & permissions → Permission management → Autostart), turn it on for this app.
Open the app once after each update
vivo doesn\'t reconnect the notification listener after an app update. Opening the app once is enough; it reconnects by itself.
Settings → Apps → this app → Battery → Unrestricted.
Keep it out of \"Deep sleeping apps\"
Settings → Battery → Background usage limits: make sure the app isn\'t in \"Sleeping apps\" or \"Deep sleeping apps\".
Phone Manager → Permissions → Background management → this app → Allow background running.
Settings → Apps → this app → Battery: \"Not optimized\" or \"Unrestricted\".
If the system has switches like \"Autostart\" or \"Background running\", turn them on for this app.
